subject: english
question:
Choose the option which is similar in meaning to the underlined word.s

I hope you are not going to __abandon__ your project.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Forsake**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"abandon"** means to leave something or someone behind, often permanently, or to give up on something entirely. (छोड़ देना)
 
 
• **Example:** He decided to abandon the project due to lack of funding.
 

 
• The word **"forsake"** has a similar meaning as "abandon." It means to give up, leave, or renounce something important or valued. (त्याग देना)
 
 
• **Example:** She could never forsake her family, no matter what happened.
 

 
• Hence, the correct synonym for "abandon" is **"forsake."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Forsake**.

---

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cherish** (संजोना): To hold something dear or value it greatly.
 
 
• **Example:** She cherishes the memories of her childhood.
 
 

 
• **Support** (सहायता करना): To give assistance, encouragement, or approval.
 
 
• **Example:** They supported their friend during a difficult time.
 
 

 
• **Accede to** (सहमति देना): To agree to a demand, request, or treaty.
 
 
• **Example:** The king acceded to the demands of his subjects.
